data.title: 五和 · 集装箱港口的钢丝暗器疾舞
data.description: 学园都市深夜码头高耸的集装箱阵列间，月色清寒。五和双手舞动海军用枪与天草式术式钢丝，数十道寒芒在夜空编织成致命罗网，身手矫健凌厉，目光专注果断。
data.location: industrial shipping container port under clear moonlight with sea cranes in background
data.action: leaping agilely between shipping containers, wielding navy cross lance and manipulating glowing razor-wire threads with intense combat resolve
data.lighting: 高空月光寒辉与钢丝折射白芒
data.promptProse: Itsuwa leaps between towering shipping containers wielding her naval lance and razor wires, cutting a fierce combat silhouette under the bright moon.
data.animaCaption: Moonlight glints off her woven steel threads as she lands with lethal precision between the containers.
